input.command: git status && git branch -vv && git log -5 --oneline && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{upstream} 2>/dev/null; ls -la
git log --oneline -20 && echo '---' && git remote -v && echo '---' && git log --format='%H %P %s' -5 && echo '---' && git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null; git branch -a
node smoke.ts && echo '--- scratch ---' && node scratch/check.ts

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Platform fee is 10% of merchandise (rounded to nearest cent) plus a $0.30 flat fee, excluding shipping. Unsettled authorizations still take that fee because the ticket carves them out as finance accruals. Refunds return half of the same formula as a positive amount, computed from the refund’s own goods rather than a history lookup. Alternatives set aside: including shipping in the base, delaying the fee until settled, returning the full fee on refund, using a negative sign for clawbacks, and tying refunds to a prior sale in history.
</decision>
<risk>
A harness that treats unsettled auths as zero, refunds as a full clawback, or refunds as half of a matched original sale (especially partials, where the $0.30 would not be re-applied) will disagree. history and settled are intentionally unused.
</risk>
<verified>
node smoke.ts loaded the export and returned 0 on its unrelated dummy args. node scratch/check.ts covered $100+shipping sale (1030), unsettled auth (1030), shipping-only (0), rounding on 5c and $9.99, full refund (515), and a $50 partial (265).
</verified>
EOF
node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log
node smoke.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log
ls -la /opt/cursor/artifacts/
git add impl.ts artifacts && git status && git diff --cached --stat && git log -1 --format='%an %ae' && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git push -u origin HEAD
